title: A Tiny Bird Drinks Blood From Birds Many Times Its Size
subject: vampire finch

scenes.text: A tiny bird on the Galapagos drinks blood from birds far bigger than itself.
It lives on two remote islands, Wolf and Darwin, where food and fresh water are scarce.
It lands on a booby and pecks the skin until blood appears.
The booby swats at it. But several finches can attack at once, so it can't defend itself.
It drinks mostly in the dry season, when almost nothing else is available.
Scientists think its ancestors picked parasites off big birds, until one pecked a little too hard.

description:
A tiny finch on the Galapagos drinks blood from boobies far bigger than itself.
On remote Wolf and Darwin islands it pecks a booby's skin until blood flows, and several finches can feed at once. It does it most in the dry season, when food and water are scarce.
Would you ever drink blood to survive?
first_comment: It also steals booby eggs. Would you have guessed a finch could be this ruthless?
